([[Orlando, Florida]]) |college = [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] (2018–2019) |draft_year = |draft_round = |draft_pick = |draft_team = |career_start = |years1 = |team1 = |highlights = *[[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2018 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2018]]) *McDonald's All-American Game MVP (2018) *[[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2018) *Jordan Brand Classic Co-MVP (2018) }} '''Nassir Shamai Little''' (born February 11, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]]. He played high school basketball at [[Orlando Christian Prep]] in [[Orlando, Florida]]. The {{convert|6|ft|6|in|m|abbr=on}} [[small forward]] was one of the top-ranked players in his class. ==High school career== Little was named a [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] in [[2018 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2018]], being named [[most valuable player]] (MVP) at the All-Star game after scoring 28 points and adding five rebounds, one assist and one steal. He also won the Jordan Brand Classic MVP after putting up 24 points in 25 minutes.
